title: carex limosa var. irrigua
intro: Carex limosa var. irrigua, commonly known as Sedge or Cotton-Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body and mind. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
